title: DeployBatchNFTMinter.s.sol hardcodes assumed DISPATCHER_INDEX / USDC nudge token with no on-chain deploy-time cross-check against dispatcher.primeToken()
description: DeployBatchNFTMinter.s.sol hardcodes DISPATCHER_INDEX (ASSUMED=4, L48) and USDC as the nudge token, and the broadcast guards do NOT verify on-chain that the nudge token differs from the pinned dispatcher's primeToken() (that equality is only enforced at batchMint RUNTIME). A wrong index pins the batcher to the wrong dispatcher / payment asset at deploy; the misconfig is caught later by the runtime revert, not at deploy.
impact: None directly. A wrong DISPATCHER_INDEX pins the BatchNFTMinter to the wrong dispatcher/payment asset; failure surfaces only at batchMint runtime (equality guard reverts) -> redeploy/repoint needed. No funds lost; operational rework only. Non-obvious deploy-config coupling (Law-3 footgun), blast radius bounded by the runtime guard. Low.
attackPath: 1. Operator runs the deploy script with the assumed DISPATCHER_INDEX=4 without confirming it matches the intended dispatcher on-chain.
2. Script broadcasts; no on-chain assert that nudgeToken != dispatcher.primeToken() (or that index 4 is the intended dispatcher).
3. A wrong index pins the BatchNFTMinter to the wrong dispatcher/payment asset.
4. Failure surfaces only at batchMint runtime (equality guard reverts) -> a redeploy/repoint is needed.
recommendation: Add an on-chain deploy-time assert that nudgeToken != dispatcher.primeToken() AND that the resolved dispatcher at DISPATCHER_INDEX is the intended one, failing the broadcast rather than deferring the misconfig to runtime.
category: Low deploy-script operator footgun (Law-3 non-obvious deploy-config coupling; runtime-revert-mitigated, redeploy-recoverable)
